title: Stable influence and the stability curve
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $g:\{−1,1\}^n\to\{−1,1\}$, and let $\rho\in\mathbb R$. The stable influence at coordinate $0$ of the function on $n+1$ coordinates obtained by multiplying the leading coordinate by $g$ on the remaining coordinates, after converting its values to real numbers, equals the stability curve of the real-valued version of $g$ at $\rho$.
